title: “We must obey God rather than men.” — Acts 5:29
paragraphs: “We must obey God rather than men.” — Acts 5:29

There comes a moment when obedience costs approval.
Crowds feel safe—but they don’t carry authority.
Faithfulness often sounds like silence… until heaven responds.

You don’t need to be liked to be led.
You need courage to obey.

If this stirred something in you, pause before scrolling.
Ask yourself: Who am I obeying when it’s uncomfortable?
